Initial release of AI Subtitle Generator — Generate and Embed Video Subtitles

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM video files (up to 500MB) for automatic AI subtitle generation and embedding.
- Supports multiple subtitle languages; output is a captioned 1080p MP4 video.
- Fast processing (30–60 seconds via cloud GPU), ideal for YouTubers, educators, and creators.
- Simple workflow: upload video, specify subtitle languages or format, download the result.
- Built-in handling of credits, file size, and common errors; transparent messaging for session status and export progress.
